answer: Latency Island Seeding: each identity gets a unique, isolated shard whose first 72 hours run at 40% throughput, so clones start at an operational nadir while originals amortize warmup. A sable audit trail links every action to its shard's creation epoch; duplicated behavioral fingerprints trigger shard merger into a shared slow pool. Marginal clone cost: lost throughput plus permanent cooldown, strictly negative-EV per identity.
